label: rem:glossary-descent
title: Descent
html: Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum observable universe and let \{A_n\}_{n \geq 0} be the recursive brane tower. The descent is the reverse traversal of the tower. We pass from level n to level n{-}1 by applying the restriction morphism r_n \colon A_n = J^1(A_{n-1}) \to A_{n-1}. In the archimedean realisation, this restricts the connection and bundle to the base manifold M_{n-1}. The descent terminates in finitely many steps, bounded by \mathrm{Krulldim} Z(\mathrm{End}_{\mathbf{C}}(A)).
